events.verdict: Brunson (NYK) brings an arm to Siakam's (IND) side but the contact is marginal during his shot attempt.
Nesmith (IND) moves laterally into Brunson (NYK), initiating more-than-marginal contact during his driving shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) and Towns (NYK) avoid making illegal contact with Siakam (IND) during his driving shot attempt.
Nesmith (IND) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Shamet (NYK) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. The contact by Shamet during Siakam's (IND) drive to the basket is marginal and play resumes with a jump ball.
Nesmith (IND) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) legally contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Towns (NYK) establishes a screening position in Nesmith's (IND) path and does not deliver contact.
Nesmith (IND) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Towns (NYK) and Potter (IND) both get their hands on the ball and the ensuing contact between the players is incidental.
Jackson (IND) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Nembhard (IND) makes illegal contact to Bridges' (NYK) arm.
Indiana requests and is granted a timeout within five seconds.
Bridges (NYK) commits a take foul on Siakam (IND).
Shamet (NYK) and Jackson (IND) briefly engage and as they disengage, both players lose their balance. Shamet does not move through Jackson's space and dislodge him from his position.
Jackson (IND) legally contests Shamet's (NYK) jump shot attempt.

Nesmith (IND) makes illegal contact across Towns' (NYK) arm during his put-back shot attempt. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul occurs with 0.2 seconds remaining on the game clock.
Nesmith (IND) maintains a legal guarding position and blocks Brunson's (NYK) shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) loses control of his dribble and legally retrieves the ball.
Bridges (NYK) directly contests Jackson's (IND) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Jackson's (IND) hand after the release.
Siakam (IND) legally contests Bridges' (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Potter (IND) and Hart (NYK) come together at the same spot during the loose ball and the contact between the two players is incidental.
Nesmith (IND) makes contact to the ball during Hukporti's (NYK) layup attempt.
Bridges (NYK) commits a take foul on Nembhard (IND).
DIawara (NYK) commits a take foul on Nembhard (IND).
Hart (NYK) commits a take foul on Siakam (IND).
